_doc: Ask AI over the journey contract (P10) — every number the answer engine uses lives here. Loaded by ask_ai/settings.py. Env ASK_AI_MODEL overrides llm.model at runtime (ops); everything else changes here.

context._doc: Character budget for what the model is shown. Blocks are added in priority order (question scope → narrative → journey summary → episodes newest-first → evidence index → portfolio rows) and the first block that would overflow the budget is cut; only ids actually shown to the model are citable.

scope._doc: Without an account_id the question is read for scope: an account name from the portfolio in the text selects that account; otherwise these phrases (or no match at all) mean portfolio.
